response.opening: Hi Reyansh, Daily Care Medicos here. Aapke last visit ke baad thoda gap raha hai—jab bhi zaroorat ho, hum yahin hain.
response.detail: Aap hamare saath 12 baar aa chuke hain; hum aapke liye regular medicines ka WhatsApp refill reminder set kar sakte hain, taaki agla refill miss na ho.
response.ask: Kya hum reminder set karein? Reply YES.
response.rationale: Last-visit gap, 12 visits, and refill-reminder insight used; warm winback reduces effort without making medical claims.
